CustomField.description: Makes this command answer with one of the Agent's Prompt Templates, by its AIPromptTemplate__c.DeveloperName__c (a name rather than an Id, so the record works in every org). Blank leaves the choice to the Agent's default template, or to the model.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the Developer Name of a Prompt Template belonging to the Agent this command is for, so the command answers with that template. Leave blank to use the default.
CustomField.label: Prompt Template Developer Name
